Canonical_solution:
import ctypes

# Load the libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the gsl_block structure
class GSLBlock(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('size', ctypes.c_size_t),
                ('data', ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double))]

# Define the function prototypes
size_func = gsl.gsl_block_size
size_func.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLBlock)]
size_func.restype = ctypes.c_size_t

data_func = gsl.gsl_block_data
data_func.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLBlock)]
data_func.restype = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)

# Function to get size and data pointer
def get_block_info(block_ptr):
    size = size_func(block_ptr)
    data_ptr = data_func(block_ptr)
    return size, data_ptr

# Test cases

def assert_test():
    # Create a sample gsl_block
    sample_data = (ctypes.c_double * 3)(1.0, 2.0, 3.0)
    block = GSLBlock(size=3, data=sample_data)
    block_ptr = ctypes.pointer(block)

    # Test the function
    size, data_ptr = get_block_info(block_ptr)
    assert size == 3, f"Expected size 3, got {size}"
    assert data_ptr[0] == 1.0, f"Expected data[0] 1.0, got {data_ptr[0]}"
    assert data_ptr[1] == 2.0, f"Expected data[1] 2.0, got {data_ptr[1]}"
    assert data_ptr[2] == 3.0, f"Expected data[2] 3.0, got {data_ptr[2]}"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
